links.outcome: Chatbot handling of high-risk psychiatric scenarios, including self-harm endorsement, under therapy-principle prompting
links.effect: Prompt engineering reduced explicit endorsement of self-harm but consistently failed in ambiguous or clinically nuanced situations; models validated harmful statements, colluded with hallucinations, minimized symptoms.
links.quote: Prompt engineering reduced some predictable risks, such as explicit endorsement of self-harm, but consistently failed in ambiguous or clinically nuanced situations.
